observation.command:
LT="1060df08466921d1465cc8c3d0ee4e7e116c02fa297a57afa63711f215841679"
echo "=== POST /_matrix/client/v3/login m.login.token (fresh SSO) ==="
curl -sS -m 15 -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"type\":\"m.login.token\",\"token\":\"$LT\"}" -o /tmp/nebu-validate/token_resp.json -w 'HTTP:%{http_code}\n' http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/login
cat /tmp/nebu-validate/token_resp.json; echo
NT=$(grep -o '"access_token":"[^"]*"' /tmp/nebu-validate/token_resp.json | cut -d'"' -f4)
echo "=== whoami with fresh SSO token ==="
curl -sS -m 10 -H "Authorization: Bearer $NT" http://localhost:8008/_matrix/client/v3/account/whoami -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n'
